label: late-episode (trial>~85) D2 after a1->S1, growing with trial; larger after unrewarded/S2 trial
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 85, 0, 20) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 85, 0, 20) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 85, 0, 20) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (ep_trial >= 70) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 85, 0, 20) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 85, 0, 20) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (1 - (action == 1) * (state == 1)) * (ep_trial >= 70)
explanation: Fires only at D2 when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 (common), in the last ~15 trials of the episode; zero at D1/GO and at D2 for any other choice/state (a negative term removes the late-decile timing baseline from non-a1-S1 D2 steps). Magnitude grows roughly linearly with ep_trial past ~85 (about 0.02-0.07 per trial, reaching ~2-4 by trial 99). On a1-S1 D2 steps it is larger when the previous trial was unrewarded (about +0.03/trial), when the previous trial reached S2 (e.g. a1 S2 rare; about +0.13/trial past 85), and when the ideal-observer belief favours S1 (belief_lo, positive slope); it is smaller when the previous choice was a2 (switch to a1; about -0.14/trial). All terms are observed at D2 (action, state reached, previous trial, belief), no model outputs or future variables. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.69 vs ~0.43 for the late-ramp a1-S1 term alone; profile 'all' additive-table ceiling is only 0.12 because those tables lack the within-decile episode ramp. The earlier value/policy description (low value, a1-leaning policy at D2) is replaced by observed quantities with no apparent loss (the profile showed value/policy deciles add ~0.04 as tables).

issues: The score reproduces: test R^2 beyond timing is 0.7057 with the 7 claimed terms. The core claims also hold. The feature is zero at D1 and GO, and the a1-S1 ramp at D2 is real: per-trial weights for a1-S1 at D2 rise steadily, about 0.15 at t84, 0.44 at t88, 0.68 at t92, 1.07 at t94, 1.48 at t96 and 1.76 at t98.

The claim 'larger when the previous trial was unrewarded' is wrong as a general statement. It comes almost entirely from one pattern, a1 S2 u (rare transition, unrewarded). Scored one at a time with the base ramp and the clearing term (test): last_is('a1 S2 u') gets +0.184 per trial (R^2 0.681). last_is('a1 S1 u') gets -0.097, so a common-unrewarded previous trial LOWERS the activation. last_is('a1 S2 r') is about +0.02. prev_reward==0 alone gives only 0.588.
The 'larger when the previous trial reached S2' claim is the same a1 S2 u effect described a second way. It is not a general S2 effect: last_is('a2 S2 u') is -0.02.

Belief adds little. Once the previous-trial pattern is modelled properly, the belief_lo weight drops to about 0.006. Dropping it changes test R^2 from 0.712 to 0.700, so the 'positive belief_lo slope' claim is weak.
'Zero at D2 for any other choice or state' is slightly overstated: a2->S1 (rare) D2 steps late in the episode sometimes fire, e.g. 0.36 at t98.

One systematic error class remains. The ramp starts at different times in different episodes: the worst-fit windows have about 3-3.9 at t92-93 a1-S1 D2 where about 1 is predicted. The prev_action==2 term also produces negative predictions, e.g. -0.83 at t99 against an actual 1.5. The misses tables still show under-prediction at D2 after a1 S2 u (+0.056).
